content.rendered:
Due to the fact that our building in under construction and off-limits to our staff until Monday, August 27th, our traditional Supply Night for the 2018-2019 year is canceled.  Grades 1-5 students should  bring their supplies on the first day of school, Tuesday, September 4th.  Kinder students should bring their supplies on their first day of orientation.  Kindergarten families will receive more information in the mail regarding their schedules.  All families are welcome to visits the classrooms briefly that morning.  We apologize for the this inconvenience and thank you in advance for your patience and understanding.   

Class list will be posted on the front doors of the school, Friday, August 24th at 4:00
